skills.name: runway-dev-characters
skills.description: Build, modify, debug, or verify Runway Characters integrations: inspect preset or custom avatars with MCP, manage live Sessions via SDK, and connect the application UI. Use with +runway-dev. UI says Characters; MCP/API use avatars. Not for avatar video generation endpoints.

skills.name: runway-dev-model-routers
skills.description: Build, modify, debug, or verify Runway Model Routers: inspect live config and eligible models via MCP, manage approved settings, integrate routed SDK calls, and inspect routing results. Use with +runway-dev. Not for direct per-model endpoints or agent REST CLI.

skills.name: runway-dev-models
skills.description: Build, modify, debug, or verify Runway model generation in an application: discover accessible models and constraints with MCP, implement SDK calls, and wire inputs and outputs into the product UI. Use with +runway-dev. Not for Model Routers, Characters, recipes, or agent-side generate scripts.

skills.name: runway-dev-recipes
skills.description: Choose, build, modify, debug, or verify Runway recipe integrations: match a recipe to the user's use case, follow its current contract, implement SDK client.recipes calls, and wire results into the application. Use with +runway-dev. Not for direct model endpoints or Model Routers.

skills.name: runway-dev-workflows
skills.description: Build, modify, debug, or verify integrations that expose Runway app workflows as API endpoints. Use get_workflows_setup_guide for current setup and API guidance. Use with +runway-dev. Not for model generation, routers, or Characters sessions.

skills.name: runway-dev
skills.description: Foundation for building, modifying, debugging, or verifying Runway Dev Platform integrations in an application: connect Dev MCP, use llms.txt to find current resources, resolve project context, use SDK wait helpers, and handle errors. Load with relevant runway-dev-* surface skills. Not for direct media generation scripts or REST CLI shortcuts.

skills.name: rw-check-org-details
skills.description: Query the Runway API for organization details: rate limits, credit balance, usage tier, and daily generation counts
headings: Step 1: Verify API Key Is Available

skills.name: rw-generate-audio
skills.description: Generate audio using the Runway API via runnable scripts. Supports TTS, sound effects, voice isolation, dubbing, and voice conversion.

skills.name: rw-generate-image
skills.description: Generate images directly using the Runway API via runnable scripts. Supports text-to-image with optional reference images.

skills.name: rw-generate-video
skills.description: Generate videos directly using the Runway API via runnable scripts. Supports text-to-video, image-to-video, and video-to-video with seedance2, gen4.5, veo3, and more.

skills.name: use-runway-api
skills.description: Directly use the Runway API from the agent to generate media, manage resources, and inspect account state

headings: Dev Platform (integrate via Dev MCP + SDK)
